div.span: AI Agent Conversational Control Flow & Workflow

Receive Inbound Utterance
(Voice Stream / Chat Text)

Send Response to User
(Voice Audio / Text)

Prompt User for Missing Details
('Which date do you prefer?')

Ask User Explicit Confirmation
('Confirm booking Dr. Sarah at 2 PM?')

Dispatch Tool via REST API
(Clinic Backend Verification)

Catch Conflict (Slot Taken)
& Query Next Available Slots
